name: @crit-fumble/threejs
description: Framework-agnostic three.js render core for Crit-Fumble surfaces (PlayTable + the FoundryVTT plugin). Pure logic — THREE is host-injected, no runtime three import, no @crit-fumble/shared dep.

scripts.//test:viewer: GLOBBED on purpose: this script used to name 4 files by hand while 8 existed, so half the browser suite ran nowhere. A new tests/*.browser.mjs is picked up automatically.
scripts.test:viewer: for f in tests/*.browser.mjs; do echo "── $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:viewer
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
